benchmarkScript:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp/hermes-intl-extension
bootstrap="$PWD/$(rg '\.hbc$' /tmp/hermes-plural-magrinj-bytecode-path)"
run_variant() {
  case "$1" in
    before) taskset -c 0 /tmp/hermes-rtf-direct-number-hires "$2" ;;
    after) taskset -c 0 /tmp/hermes-list-inline-final-hires "$2" ;;
    magrinj) FORMATJS_BENCH_BOOTSTRAP="$bootstrap" taskset -c 0 /tmp/hi-host-optimized "$2" ;;
  esac
}
for round in 1 2 3; do
  if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='magrinj after before'; else variants='before after magrinj'; fi
  for variant in $variants; do
    run_variant "$variant" /tmp/hermes-list-default-overlap.hbc > "/tmp/hermes-list-inline-final-$variant-$round.jsonl"
  done
  for variant in $variants; do
    run_variant "$variant" /tmp/hermes-canonical-control.hbc > "/tmp/hermes-list-inline-final-tag-$variant-$round.jsonl"
  done
  for variant in $variants; do
    run_variant "$variant" /tmp/hermes-list-size-control.hbc > "/tmp/hermes-list-inline-final-size-$variant-$round.jsonl"
  done
  for variant in $variants; do
    run_variant "$variant" /tmp/hermes-canonical-locale-control.hbc > "/tmp/hermes-list-inline-final-locale-$variant-$round.jsonl"
  done
done

order: Three complete 33-case overlap invocations plus tag, Locale and list-size controls per host. Rounds 1 and 3 before/after/magrinj; round 2 reverses. Constructor and RTF controls follow with same alternating order. CPU0 for every host. No builds or profiling during timings.
outputChecks: 459 values checked (297 overlap, 27 canonical tag, 18 isolated Locale, 45 list-size, 36 constructor, 36 relative-time). All FormatJS before/after values match. Comparator differences restricted to omitted/unsupported ListFormat default locale en-US versus en.
change: Rust validates UTF16 slices into a stack array for up to eight inputs; Cow retains existing exact-capacity Vec fallback for larger lists. C++ returns empty strings before input-buffer setup and uses stack arrays for up to four UTF16 strings and ABI slices, heap vectors beyond. Iterator semantics, private JS input copying, validation, output ownership and lone surrogates remain unchanged.
